name: anti-entropy-governance
title_zh: 删旧逻辑前先问三遍的代码减负员
tagline_zh: 重构时总怕删错？它自动标出退休逻辑、重复归属、多余回退，动刀前要你点头，专治「不敢删」和「删过头」两种手抖。
tagline_en: Refactoring without fear: flags dead code, duplicate owners, and stale fallbacks, then waits for your nod before.
desc_en: Use when touching retiring old logic, collapsing duplicate owners, removing fallbacks, or schema/persistence/source-of-truth boundaries; identify opportunities automatically; destructive execution requires explicit confirmation.
why_zh: 不是 lint 也不是 IDE 重构——它把「该删什么」变成可审计的清单，每次破坏性操作都卡在确认门。
why_en: Not a linter or IDE refactor—it turns 'what to delete' into an auditable list, gating every destructive move behind your.
limit_zh: 只认代码库里的结构性熵（旧逻辑、重复归属、回退、schema 边界）；不查 bug、不查安全、不查性能。
limit_en: Only structural entropy: dead logic, duplicate owners, fallbacks, schema boundaries. No bug/security/perf checks. Needs readable git history to.
title_en: Code slimmer that asks thrice before deleting old logic
